subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should become part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group session history be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The fix changes a durable session-key and authorization boundary, so automation can identify the missing discriminator but cannot safely choose the compatibility and security tradeoff.

options.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
options.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and add doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: Platform Identity-Scoped Sessions
options.body: Use a Feishu platform identity such as appId or a proven bot identity if maintainers prefer platform semantics over OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer To Broader Feishu Identity Design
options.body: Keep this issue open while related Feishu mention, context, and DM identity work converge on a shared model.

recommendation.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
recommendation.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and add doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-code and review-history owner for the exact Feishu session identity surface.
